purpose: Hand-verified test set for the crossing algorithm (see 'Manual verification of crossings' in README.md). Every crossing the algorithm counts on these videos must be a real crossing in front of the camera (target precision 100%). Reviewed with crossing_review.py; labels are saved in _output/crossing_review/labels/<video_id>.json.
